title: pe-key-scanner configuration
description: Controls how pe-key-scanner enumerates partitions, mounts them and where the discovered SSH private key is stored.

temp_mount_dir.description: Pool directory holding temporary mount points. One subdirectory is created per unmounted filesystem and mounted there; the pool itself is never mounted on. Cleanup only ever unmounts and rmdir's (never recursive), so a failed unmount cannot delete a volume's contents, and cleanup failures are warnings that do not affect the exit code.

search_path.description: Path looked up relative to the root of every scanned filesystem.

output.description: Destination file for the first key found. Parent directory is created with mode 700 and the key is written with mode 600.

stop_on_first.description: Stop as soon as the first key is found.

case_insensitive.description: Match search_path case-insensitively (FAT/NTFS filesystems are case-insensitive).

mount_options.description: Extra mount options appended after `ro`, keyed by filesystem type. Example: { "vfat": "utf8=true" }.
